units.source_text: 女人和往常一样，隔着围炉的背面，躺在地席的门坎处；

en.t: As usual, the woman lay beyond the far side of the hearth, at the threshold of the mat-covered floor;

units.source_text: 她从头到脚盖了一件洗褪了色的浴衣，抱着膝盖缩成一团，轻轻地打着鼾。

en.t: She was covered from head to foot with a washed-out yukata, curled up hugging her knees, and snoring softly.

units.source_text: 打那天以后，她不再裸体睡觉了，可浴衣之下仍然没穿衣服。

en.t: Since that day, she no longer slept naked, but under the yukata she still wore nothing.

units.source_text: 他迅速地瞄了一遍社会版和地方栏。

en.t: He quickly scanned the social news page and the local column.

units.source_text: 当然，既没找到“失踪启事”，也没看到“寻人广告”。

en.t: Of course, he found neither a missing-person notice nor a personal advertisement looking for someone.

units.source_text: 这是早就预料到的，所以，他也没有灰心丧气。

en.t: He had expected this from the beginning, so he was not discouraged.

units.source_text: 他悄悄地起了床，下到了泥地房间。

en.t: He quietly got out of bed and went down into the earthen-floored room.

units.source_text: 男人也只穿着人造丝的短裤衩，上身完全赤裸。

en.t: The man too was wearing only rayon shorts, his upper body completely bare.

units.source_text: 确实，这种打扮，人要舒服得多。

en.t: Indeed, dressed like this, a person felt much more comfortable.

units.source_text: 短裤衩的绳子勒进腰部，腰部周围蓄着沙子，只有这部分红红的，还起了炎症，刺痒痒的。

en.t: The cord of his shorts cut into his waist, sand had collected around it, and only that area was red, inflamed, and prickling with itch.
